description: JStock is open on the Portfolio Management tab. Your task is to record a partial sale of 10 shares of NVDA (NVIDIA Corp.) from the existing portfolio on Dec 15, 2024, at a price of $950.00 per share (0 fees). After recording the transaction in JStock, create a text report at '/home/ga/Documents/tax_lot_report.txt' documenting the tax lot details: Cost Basis ($6,153.00), Sale Proceeds ($9,500.00), Realized Gain ($3,347.00), and remaining shares (15). The report must clearly label these values.
